title: A Ledger for the Inheritance
author: Noor Sandoval
blurb: Vesper Whitlock, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
